newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria sees 12 bln ATS 1997 group op profit.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria sees 12 bln ATS 1997 group op profit.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Thursday it expected 1997 operating profit for the group including Creditanstalt to reach 12 billion schillings.

"We are aiming to hit the 12 billion schilling mark," finance chief Franz Zwickl told a news conference. Bank Austria acquired the state's 70 percent voting stake in its former competitor Creditanstalt in January.
"It's ambitious but we can reach it," Zwickl added.
The 1997 target would compare to between 11 and 12 billion schillings in 1996 if Creditanstalt had been included in Bank Austria's group figures, Zwickl added. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
